title: RFI for developer trial conversion
not_questions: Salesforce owns the opportunity and Snowflake holds trial usage events.
We will not license Adobe Journey Optimizer for this procurement.
Respond against the printed references and retain the precision of any reported conversion rate.

questions.label: A.1
questions.text: Describe how Marketo Engage would send qualified trial requests to Salesforce when a developer signs up twice with different email addresses.

questions.label: A.2
questions.text: Map the Marketo Engage consent fields for a trial signup and a webinar registration. Explain which record a sales representative sees after a developer withdraws consent.

questions.label: A.3
questions.text: Provide a Marketo Engage routing rehearsal for two developers from the same account who request calls in different territories. Identify the Salesforce owner for each case.

questions.label: A.4
questions.text: Explain how our operations team would pause a Marketo Engage nurture campaign during an outage and confirm that paused contacts receive no duplicate messages.

questions.label: B.1
questions.text: Describe how Customer Journey Analytics would relate Snowflake trial usage to paid subscriptions when the contract covers several developer workspaces.

questions.label: B.2
questions.text: Define a Customer Journey Analytics trial activation metric that ignores automated API calls and preserves a reproducible denominator.

questions.label: B.3
questions.text: Show how an analyst would use Customer Journey Analytics to compare two release cohorts while handling a partial week of trial data.

questions.label: B.4
questions.text: Explain how you would reconcile a Customer Journey Analytics renewal count with a Snowflake month-end snapshot and record any unresolved variance.

questions.label: C.1
questions.text: Identify the delivery lead and the backup available during our quarter-end change freeze. State each person's expected weekly hours.

questions.label: C.2
questions.text: Provide a reference from a software subscription client that reconciled events with bookings and identify the work your firm performed.

questions.label: C.3
questions.text: Itemize your professional fees for the pilot and the optional rollout, including which trial volumes would change your price.

questions.label: C.4
questions.text: Describe your firm's handover commitments if we take support in-house after the pilot. State the charge for one additional training session.
